title: Map rules: the numbers behind the map's dressing (art/places/map-rules.json)

box.description: A rectangle of cells round a tile, counted from it: left, right, up, down

noise.description: A fractal noise field read at world position: scale is its frequency (per tile), octaves its layers; threshold, where a rule uses one, is the level above which the field counts

family.description: A kind of cluster in a biome: B = block size in tiles, used = share of blocks holding one, size = [smallest, largest] members, keep = smallest size kept (smaller is dropped whole), minD2 = least squared distance between two members

biomes.description: The biome table, in a fixed order (a biome's place in it is part of its seeds). reeds = share of shore stretches with a reed bed, pads = share of open-water tiles with a lily pad, broad = share of groves of the broad kind, pebbles = share of sand tiles

clear.description: Plain-tile radius in cells: props, shrubs and meadow decor need the tile and every tile this near it to be one terrain (pattern size 2 * clear + 1)

usedSwing.description: How far the grove noise swings a family's `used` share (0.5 = up to half again)

touchD2.description: Largest squared step from a member to the next one grown, by family

minD2.description: Least squared distance between two members when the family names none

bisector.description: How many tiles a tile keeps from the border between two clusters' claims

wayZone.description: Cells kept clear of props round a way up, counted from its rectangle

clearing.description: The plain grass a Hollow Tree's site needs round its foot tile

noOverlap.description: When true the scatter drops a meadow piece (tuft, flower, clump, fleck) whole if its picture's rectangle overlaps another piece's, a prop's or another meadow piece's; the piece with the lower hash goes

target.description: The desk's rule as a share of open tiles; the raw chances below are tuned to it (not read by the generator)

reach.description: How far a drift's seed may lie from a tile of it

drift.description: The offsets a drift's second and third flowers take from its seed

sameKind.description: Share of a drift's flowers that are the seed's own kind

apart.description: Cells an accent clump keeps to itself (pattern size 2 * apart + 1)

margin.description: Pixels a fleck keeps from its tile's edge (tiles are 16 pixels)

sizes.description: Width and height in pixels of each fleck look

clearOfProps.description: Cells round a prop's foot tile where no fleck lies

smallPatchMax.description: A scrub patch of at most this many tiles with no tile a full cell off its edge still takes one shrub

padClear.description: A lily pad needs the tile and every tile this near it to be water

stretch.description: Side of a shore stretch in tiles (even); a stretch has a reed bed by the biome's `reeds` share

reach.description: Cells a reed's foot may lie beyond the rectangle asked for

startSteps.description: A bed starts 0 to this many pixels minus one along the edge

spacing.description: Pixels between clumps: min, plus 0 to spread minus one

jitter.description: Pixels a clump's base is moved along the edge, either way

rag.description: Pixels a clump's base is moved across the edge, 0 to this (even)

looks.description: The shore looks and their shares, which add up to 1

within.description: In-water clumps stand only on shallow water this many cells from land

count.description: Clumps in a stretch, min to max

tone.description: The sunlit grass tone: patches of the noise above the threshold, kept whole or dropped whole; every tile needs the block of `clear` cells round it to be one ground

enabled.description: When false the scatter lays no tone patch (no sunlit patch is drawn); the numbers below stay for when it is switched on

patchMax.description: A patch larger than this many tiles is dropped
